proves.claim: With claim.checkCeiling on, add --check through the real CLI records a pending baseline with strict true; with it off the baseline has no strict field.

cli.journeys-check-soundness.add-records.why: Without it a new check could freeze with no measurement promised, or the default-off rollout could change silently.

proves.claim: With claim.checkCeiling on, the real claim command refuses CHECK_UNSOUND for a check that hides its output and leaves the item open.

cli.journeys-check-soundness.hidden-outp.why: Without it a check that can never show a failure freezes and unproven work passes.

proves.claim: With claim.checkCeiling on, the real claim command refuses CHECK_OVER_CEILING for a check measured over the ceiling and claims a sound strict check under it.

cli.journeys-check-soundness.over-ceilin.why: Without it a check too slow for the gate freezes, or sound checks get refused.

proves.claim: With claim.checkCeiling on, the real claim command claims an old non-strict check whose remeasure is pending.

cli.journeys-check-soundness.old-check-c.why: Without it every check frozen before the setting is blocked until a remeasure lands.

proves.claim: With claim.checkCeiling off or unset, the real claim command claims a hidden-output check and an over-ceiling check as today.

cli.journeys-check-soundness.setting-off.why: Without it the default-off rollout decision could change silently.
